architecture: Small installer-owned responsive Jarvis HTML chat frontend plus finite server-side adapter to official local API, rather than publishing full Electron renderer or wildcard backend proxy. Real textarea/contenteditable input opens native phone keyboard, streamed response and stop/new/history controls; restrained dark/cyan Jarvis theme inspired by futuristic assistants, responsive accessible contrast/focus and reduced-motion opt-out; no unlicensed Iron Man assets. Reuse current verified owned native runtime/provider where supported; no additional metered spend or model download. Native owner-admin app remains independently reachable only through existing protected session path.

boundary.rules: Exact method/path/closed body schemas only; server issues opaque IDs and maps to fixed default Jarvis backend session/run IDs. Client sends text and opaque IDs only, never profile/model/provider/system prompt/toolset/cwd/backend URL/session-key/API credential. Body/message/stream/rate bounds and CSP/safe markdown/XSS/CSRF/same-host-origin guards required. Unknown routes/fields denied, no redirects/wildcard proxy/PTY/files/config/messaging/Bots administration exposed.
boundary.authentication: Retain Access OTP/binding cookie, fresh JWT before all bytes/input and verified owned cloudflared ingress. Browser-managed cookies, original<=30s leases and <=5s protected heartbeat/currentness for active streams; current v263/v264 native proof applies to native admin path, not invented evidence for chat API. Verify actual selected local API process/UID/executable/listener/key custody separately. API key only server-owned protected reference, never browser/argv/logs.
boundary.ownership: Derive principal from verified issuer/audience/subject identity, not client email/header. Durable server-owned principal→conversation/run map with complete ownership check before list/read/send/events/stop/reconnect. Do not forward backend global lists. Different principals cannot read, steer/stop, reuse opaque IDs/session keys or inherit another conversation. Changes/revocation deny and close exact stream. Shared old admin chats are not auto-imported into family views.

family: Independent conversations, not simultaneous control of one canvas. Initially bound total active turns to2 and one turn per conversation; observed provider/backend capacity may reduce with honest busy/queue indication, never silently merge identities or expand budget. Two authenticated user/device sessions must coexist without ending native admin stream; persistent restart readback preserves ownership. Family Access roster requires actual owner-approved identities and owned config enrollment; current single-owner allowlist is not family authorization. Conversation separation alone does not prove memory/tool/private-file isolation: deny affected tools/global memory/context for family until current per-principal isolation/grants are verified, retain owner-admin capabilities. No copied credentials into profile homes.
home_assistant: Architecture reserves a separate optional machine ask/reply channel with dedicated protected credential and distinct principal/session ownership, never browser cookie/family-secret reuse or house-action/admin grants. Live HA configuration and implementation are DEFERRED per user priority; current answer is not wired. It can coexist conceptually with native screen via independent backend conversations, but acceptance requires future actual authenticated proof. Do not re-enable homelab work now.
feature_truth: Official native Desktop including Bots UI remains preserved; each native capability keeps its current configured/functional/accepted state. New family chat is deliberately a conversation surface, not full Desktop/browser equivalence or Bots management. Unsupported features visibly link owner-admin option/pending state rather than disappearing from original scope or claiming parity. Custom presentation follows usable mobile chat first.
